items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And my greatest compliment in the last couple of years came from Johnny Mandel. He came in to hear us at the Jazz Bakery in Los Angeles... he said, 'you know, you play like I think.'

ctx.x: Do you think there’s anybody writing tunes today that are going to become standards? © Fillius Jazz Archive -30-
Johnny Mandel is writing some gorgeous things.
